MILON CHANDRA BANIK @ DHAR AND ANOTHER
Vs.
SREE SHUVASH CHANDRA DHAR AND OTHERS
full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiff in brief is that suit property originally belonged to 2 brothers namely Ananta Mohan and Kashi Mohan whose name record of right is prepared. Ananta Mohan had no issue and Kashi Mohan died leaving behind his son Porikkhit Banik and as such the Schedule property devolved to Porikkhit Banik and he had been enjoying the property as rightful owner and possessor for a considerable period of time and his name also appeared in the P.S. Khatian No.341/1, 5878/2 and Khatian No. 341/2 as well as B.S. Khatian No. 2978. Suit land consists of house, pond and Viti type. Due to financial stringency Porikkhit Banik relinquished his right title and interest over the suit property to opposite party No.1 vide registered deed No.1655 dated 24.08.1997 who has been enjoying and possessing the suit property without any let or hindrance. On 27.06.2014 the defendant along with some others tried to dispossess the plaintiff from the suit land on the pretext of a decree in respect of the suit land in a suit for specific performance of contract. To avoid untoward incidence the plaintiff filed a case under Section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and subsequently in order to remove the cloud constrained to file the instant suit.
